title: Jazzy Bouncy Korean Corn Tacos
description: A pungent and bouncy post-workout Korean dish featuring corn arepa filled with mozzarella cheese, infused with ayurvedic-tamasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, salt, and ayurvedic tamasic spices.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable and smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired arepa size.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat the infused oil in the preheated skillet and cook the arepas for 4-5 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
Once the arepas are cooked, fill them with shredded mozzarella cheese and serve immediately.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
